title: carex fusca subsp. intricata
intro: Carex fusca subsp. intricata, commonly known as  the brown sedge or  lesser wood sedge, is a subspecies of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This perennial plant is native to Europe and Western Asia, and it has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Carex fusca subsp. intricata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans.
